title: drosera septentrionalis
intro: Drosera septentrionalis, commonly known as Northern Sundew, is a carnivorous plant species native to North America, characterized by its ability to capture and digest small insects for nutrient supplementation. This plant has been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, showcasing its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Drosera septentrionalis include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, particularly methylated droserone, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
